name: Fab Industries Inc.
old_description: Exceptional custom metal fabrication that turns your dream into reality.
about:
Fab Industries operates from Frederick, Colorado, serving the Denver metropolitan area. The company has been a metal fabrication resource for nearly two decades, with a team that collectively holds over 40 years of experience in the trade. Ownership details and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication across a range of product categories: stairways and railings for residential and commercial spaces, architectural metal elements, custom-cut panels for walls and ceilings, and handcrafted metal furniture. Its capabilities span design, fabrication, welding (including commercial, residential, and mobile on-site welding), and installation, allowing it to manage projects from concept through completion.

Customers come from commercial construction, residential building, architectural design, and furniture sectors. Projects have included custom staircases for homes and businesses, decorative metal accents for buildings, bespoke panels for interior applications, and one-of-a-kind metal furniture pieces.

Fab Industries emphasizes its depth of experience, use of high-grade materials and advanced techniques, a collaborative communication style, and the convenience of a single-source provider that handles design, fabrication, welding, and installation. Mobile welding services extend its reach to client sites for repairs and installations.
